test_title: PYST 74: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word "Lengthy".
solution:
**The correct answer is: Option 1) Concise.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Concise** means giving a lot of information clearly and in a few words; brief but comprehensive. (संक्षिप्त, संक्षेप)

 
 
• **Example:** She gave a concise summary of the report.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Concise**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their meanings:

 
• **Extended** (विस्तृत): Made longer or larger; prolonged.

 
 
• **Example:** The meeting lasted for an extended period.
 
 
 
• **Elongated** (बढ़ा हुआ): Having a shape that is longer than it is wide; lengthened.
 
 
• **Example:** The picture showed an elongated figure.
 
 
 
• **Protracted** (खिंचा हुआ): Lasting for a long time or longer than expected or usual; prolonged.
 
 
• **Example:** The negotiation process was protracted.
 
 

49:Taa1,
**The correct answer is: Option 1) Loquacious.**
